assessments.label: Evaluate performance
assessments.evidence: Calculate a conversion rate from sample campaign data and explain what the result indicates.
assessments.limit: The task supports evaluating performance in a bounded setting.

assessments.label: Optimise a campaign
assessments.evidence: Interpret the relative performance of two sets of sample results.
assessments.limit: The example provides no evidence of running and monitoring a live intervention.

assessments.label: Analyse channel strategy
assessments.evidence: Compare channel choices for a hypothetical target audience.
assessments.limit: The activity demonstrates strategic analysis within a teaching scenario.

assessments.label: Operate a social channel
assessments.evidence: Explain when to adapt the message and schedule for a different channel.
assessments.limit: Ongoing publishing, moderation and operational responsibility require further evidence.

assessments.label: Update a production site
assessments.evidence: The outline introduces page structure and presentation.
assessments.limit: The topic is relevant background. Production editing and approvals need separate evidence.

levels.text: The course introduces common campaign performance indicators.

levels.text: Explain what the conversion rate measures and why it changes.
levels.reason: The learning outcome names an action and asks learners to explain meaning.

levels.text: Calculate the conversion rate from a sample dataset and use it to compare two campaigns.
